name: Maltwort
look: a bubbling round copper kettle with barley-ear arms, a spout and a frothy crown of white foam
entry: A bubbling, copper-kettle-shaped creature with sprouting barley ears for arms and a crown of frothy white foam. It hums softly as it warms its internal sugars, attracting sweet-toothed Pokémon from miles around.
how: Evolve Hopsprout at level 18. It learns Yeast Bubble when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Barroom Blitz at level 30, and evolves into Brawlerry at level 36 once it knows it.
